description: Quantify and plot the arabinose-gene context of Firmicute G1PDH loci and its distance to pcrB
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, re
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
store=json.load(open("g1pdh_windows.json"))
meta=pd.read_csv("firmicutes_both_K00096_K07094.csv").set_index("org")
orgs=[o for o in store if "loci" in store[o]]
CATS=["araABD","arabinase","HADphos","sugarABC","pcrB","xylose"]
rows=[]
for o in orgs:
    for L in store[o]["loci"]:
        s=L["score"]
        rows.append(dict(org=o,name=meta.loc[o,"name"],fam=meta.loc[o,"D"],
                         genus=meta.loc[o,"name"].split()[0],gene=L["gene"],
                         **{c:s[c] for c in CATS}))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
df["ara_context"]=(df.araABD>=1)|(df.arabinase>=2)
print("Loci in an arabinose gene context:", int(df.ara_context.sum()), "/", len(df))
print("Genomes with >=1 ara-context G1PDH:", df[df.ara_context].org.nunique(), "/", df.org.nunique())
print("Genera:", df[df.ara_context].genus.nunique(), "of", df.genus.nunique())
print("Families:", sorted(df[df.ara_context].fam.dropna().unique()))
print("\nPer-genus table:")
t=df.groupby("genus").agg(loci=("gene","size"), ara_ctx=("ara_context","sum")).sort_values("ara_ctx",ascending=False)
print(t.to_string())
t.to_csv("per_genus_ara_context.csv")

# B. subtilis window sanity check
w=[L for L in store["bsu"]["loci"]][0]["window"]
print("\n=== bsu araM window (offset, strand, product) ===")
for x in w: print(f"  {x[0]:+d} {x[1]} {x[2]}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
obs=[(df[c]>=1).mean()*100 for c in CATS]
exp=[np.mean([store[o]["null1"][c] for o in orgs])*100 for c in CATS]
x=np.arange(len(CATS)); ax.bar(x-0.2,obs,0.4,label="observed beside G1PDH",color="#2f6f9f")
ax.bar(x+0.2,exp,0.4,label="random genomic locus (within-genome null)",color="#c8c8c8")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(["ara catabolic\n(araA/B/D)","arabinan/\narabinofuranosidase","HAD phosphatase\n(AraL-like)","sugar ABC\n(AraNPQ-like)","pcrB","xylose/\nxylulose"],fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel("% of loci with >=1 such gene within +/-5 genes")
ax.set_title("Genomic context of Firmicute G1P dehydrogenase (K00096), 67 loci in 60 genomes",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=8)
ax2=axes[1]
d=pd.read_csv("g1pdh_context.csv")
ax2.hist(d.dpcrB,bins=np.arange(0,5000,200),color="#9f5a2f")
ax2.axvline(3,color="red",ls="--"); ax2.text(120,ax2.get_ylim()[1]*0.85,"adjacency\nthreshold (3 genes)\n0 loci",color="red",fontsize=8)
ax2.set_xlabel("gene-rank distance from G1PDH gene to nearest pcrB (K07094)")
ax2.set_ylabel("number of loci"); ax2.set_title("G1PDH is never adjacent to pcrB (min = 15 genes)",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
df.to_csv("g1pdh_context_scored.csv",index=False)
